title: The Live Safehouse
author: Juniper Yarrow
blurb: Paloma Marchetti, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
